codes.name: Action Opportunity
codes.definition: The speaker invites another person to act or speak, or gives them the floor.

codes.name: Performance Output
codes.definition: The speaker contributes a task-relevant idea, proposal or piece of work.

codes.name: Positive Evaluation
codes.definition: The speaker positively evaluates another person's contribution.

codes.name: Negative Evaluation
codes.definition: The speaker negatively evaluates another person's contribution.

codes.name: Influence
codes.definition: The speaker changes position or accepts another person's view.
